record.question: A 7 year old child with Nephrotic syndrome is regarded as having marked hypoalbuminaemia when the serum albumin level is:
record.explanation: Answer B: Below 2 g/dl. In pediatric nephrotic syndrome, serum albumin below about 2 g/dL is commonly described as marked/severe hypoalbuminemia. Source/context note: Diagnostic definitions commonly use albumin <2.5 g/dL; the term “marked” is not standardized. Reference: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/kidney-disease/children/nephrotic-syndrome-children. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
